choices: In this study, you will be presented with 8 truns of multiple SOAP sentences from the doctors release Note and your task is to verify medical intent annotated per sentence. In the release note the doctor summeriesd their conversation with the patients including the assessment and treatment plan. Each listed sentence or sentences has only one intent.

One sample you annotate is documnetd by the doctor after the interview.
E.g:
The onset of her pain began 7 days ago, when she was playing basketball and another player ran into her

You will verify medical intents of Release Note. All samples were annotated by the study owners (non-medical professionals). We've annotated the samples leveraging an annotation guide, which we created in multiple rounds in close cooperation with a doctor.

Please have a read through the annotation guideline, before you start verifying the samples. In the guideline you'll be introduced to all the intent classes with multiple examples per intent.
Annotation guidelines (Google Doc)
We hope that these intent annotations will benefit the medical NLP community towards building more resilient medical dialogue systems.
